description: This source file defines a SwiftUI view component 'OpenClawChatComposer' which presents a chat input UI with features like session selection, model selection, thinking level, attachments handling, and message sending. It includes platform-specific code for macOS and iOS, with additional code to handle file and image attachments, text editing, and clipboard pasting support.

classes.name: ChatComposerTextView
classes.description: An NSViewRepresentable wrapper around a custom NSTextView subclass, enabling text editing, message sending on Return key, and paste handling for macOS.

classes.name: ChatComposerNSTextView
classes.description: A custom NSTextView subclass that intercepts key events and pasteboard interactions to support message sending and image pasting.

classes.name: ChatComposerPasteSupport
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods for handling image and file URL pasting on macOS.

methods.name: pickFilesMac
methods.description: Opens an NSOpenPanel to select image files for attachment on macOS.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles file URL drops on macOS, processing dropped files as attachments.

methods.name: loadPhotosPickerItems
methods.description: Loads image data from PhotosPickerItems asynchronously on iOS.
